verdict.rationale: No first-party bulk or batch operation is documented. Bulk work is only possible indirectly: the pplx CLI returns structured JSON for shell pipelines, so users can script many queries. Computer, reachable via MCP, can run multi-step tasks with sandboxed code and 400+ connectors, which could process many items. missing for 10: a native batch/bulk API or UI for acting on many items at once, documentation of bulk workflows or limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk use.
